value.body: The M.Ed is a two-year postgraduate degree in education, regulated by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE). It covers education theory, research methods, curriculum and teacher education, with a dissertation, and prepares graduates to train teachers and to work in educational research and administration.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A B.Ed, an integrated B.A./B.Sc.B.Ed (such as ITEP), a B.El.Ed, or a D.El.Ed with a bachelor's degree, usually with at least 50% marks, per NCTE norms. Admission is through a university entrance test, CUET-PG at participating universities, or merit.

value.title: At a glance
items: Teaching in B.Ed and D.El.Ed colleges usually also needs UGC-NET or a PhD.
Other outcomes include roles in SCERTs and DIETs, curriculum and research work, and school leadership.
It is research-oriented, and a dissertation is part of the degree.
